purpose: Checks NAIC producer license reciprocity for non-resident filing across target states per MDL-218 and NIPR Reciprocity Matrix 2024. Returns all_reciprocal (bool), non_standard_states[] (CA, FL, NJ, NY, HI, MN, WI -- require independent filing), and coverage_by_target[] with per-state reciprocal flag, LOA gaps, and independent-filing notes. State codes and NAIC LOA enum codes only. No National Producer Numbers. Zero PII by construction.
